expand.title: 区分temper & mood
lines: temper n. 脾气，性情 This time, the policeman lost his temper. Whatever happens, remember to keep our temper. My sister is of a calm/quick temper. 我姐姐/妹妹性情平和/脾气急躁。 The boss is in a temper today. 老板今天脾气不好。 Keep your temper！别发火

n. 心情，情绪（与mood 同义） That morning he was in a good mood/temper. You should apologize to him. He's in a very bad temper.生气了 Don't disturb him. He's in a very bad mood. （不能用 temper）处于不高兴的情绪中(He is not cheerful, but not necessarily angry).

mood n. 心情，情绪；有意/想要（做某事） When he is in a bad temper, he gets angry easily. 当他脾气不好时，他很容易生气 But when he is in a bad mood, he likes to sit alone. 但当他心情不好时，他喜欢独自坐着。 At that time I was not in the mood for talking/to talk. （不能用 temper） Although Jeremy is well-known for his great sense of humour, he is in no mood for telling funny stories today. （不能用 temper） I'm in the mood for a drive into the country. 处于情绪中
